### Home {slug: dashboard}
Get here: Click "Home" at the top of the left menu.
- Client access users see "Dashboard" instead.
- Views: "Cold email" (default until you pick another; last pick remembered), "Sales", "Owner". Buttons: period buttons, "Edit layout", "New campaign".
- Four cards on every view:
  - "Cash collected": with CRM payments, payments minus refunds in USD, else "Not available". Without CRM payments, value of deals won.
  - "Calls booked": campaign leads, once per lead per campaign, still-scheduled only.
  - "Positive reply rate": positive replies of leads contacted; target 1% default.
  - "Open pipeline": open deals now, ignores period.
- Card "⋯" > "Change number"; "Reset all four cards".
- Periods: "7d", "30d" (default), "90d", "All time", "Custom" ("Apply"; max two years).

### How am I doing after 2 weeks of cold email? {slug: dashboard/faq/how-am-i-doing-after-2-weeks-of-cold-email}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Campaigns".
- Open rate 40%+; lower means a deliverability problem (check SPF, DKIM).
- Positive reply: Podcast 1-2%, Interview 0.5-1.5%, AI Business Audit 0.5-1%, Direct 0.3-0.8%.
- Bounce under 3%; above 5% pauses the campaign after 100 emails.
- Fix deliverability, then bounce, then replies.

### Access and Roles {slug: crm/access-and-roles}
Get here: Click "Settings", then "Roles & Permissions"; sharing is under "Messaging", "Sharing" tab.
- Default: Owners and Admins see and change everything, including all CRM settings. Members see and change all records. Clients use the CRM with limits.
- Clients can't: change deals they don't own (unless unowned) or deal owners; change tasks not created by or assigned to them; change others' files; merge; send texts from Conversations; use "Sequences" or "Scheduled".
- "Roles & Permissions" (missing? ask support): reach "Own records", "Their team" or "Workspace". Unowned records need "Workspace". Roles add up. Owners and Admins always full.
- Recordings and transcripts go together. "Share communications on records" (Owners and Admins; "Messaging" > "Sharing"; "Turn on sharing"; never Clients) lets viewers of a record play its recordings. Off deletes nothing.
- "Records & fields": Owners and Admins. "Pipelines": Owners, Admins, Members unless their role blocks it. "Duplicates": anyone who can merge.

  - "Launch campaign": everything is ready.
  - "Launch when ready": emails or people are still being prepared.
  - "Finish setup": the switch is off or all addresses are warming up. It saves without sending, and you launch later from the campaign page.

Get here: In the left sidebar, click "AI Inbox", or "Settings" > "Cold Email Blocklist".

  - "Pausing a campaign:" it can also remove that campaign's bounced leads, whatever your space.
  - "Never removed:" repliers, leads mid-sequence, leads not yet emailed.
  - "Asking first:" it asks a person unless an owner or admin set it to "Do it" or "Autopilot". While practicing, it removes nothing. While it asks before every change, only approved leads go. Its asks always wait, even with "Keep going if I'm busy" on.
  - Under "Fine-tune all 12 actions", choose "Ask me first" or "Never".
- Full lead storage blocks adding or importing until there is room. Delete leads from finished campaigns.

ac58196de703c40e51713a024b42e9da1a0dba61:
### One of my sending domains is on a blocklist. What should I do? {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/deliverability/one-of-my-sending-domains-is-on-a-blocklist-what-should-i-do}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Deliverability", then the "Results" tab ("Needs attention").
- Pause the domain's inboxes until it's off the list, and find the cause before sending again. Listed domains are more likely to hit spam or be blocked.
- Owners and admins get the alert "[domain] is on a blocklist". "Details" tab, then the domain under "Blocklists and spam filter", shows which lists name it.
- Click "Pause" on the alert, or remove the inboxes from campaigns. Other inboxes keep sending.
- Causes: bad-list bounces, spam complaints, spammy wording.
- The alert clears when a finished test finds the domain clean. Then turn inboxes back on in "Cold Email → Email accounts".
- Replacing the domain is usually faster. A new domain needs about 3 weeks of warm-up.
- If the listing seems a mistake, ask the support chat, with the domain name.
95e7f433b6f241443b53954104ec25047660ced5:
### What do I do if my campaign is paused for high bounce rate? {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/deliverability/what-do-i-do-if-my-campaign-is-paused-for-high-bounce-rate}
Get here: Open the campaign, then its "Leads" tab.
- Don't just resume. Clean the list, check inbox health, then restart.
- "Leads" tab, filter "Bounced". "Mailbox does not exist" or "Invalid recipient" means a bad list, the usual culprit. "Mailbox full" or "Over quota" is rare. "Spam rejected" or "Reputation error" is a worse, deliverability problem.
- "Analytics" tab: under 3% healthy, over 5% dangerous, over 10% catastrophic.
- Clean: run email verification (Email Verification toggle in Import leads). Bulk-remove bounced leads on the "Leads" tab. Consider discarding purchased lists (often 20%+ invalid).
- "Cold Email → Email accounts", "Warm-up health": 90%+ resume once cleaned. 80-90% keep warmup running and resume on fewer inboxes. Under 80% pause those inboxes from campaigns for 2-3 weeks.
- After resuming, watch "Analytics" the first day. Pause if bounces spike.
5cc5d2c2b843338b4ba3f48e1cf31cf597298162:
### What does the SPF/DKIM/DMARC deliverability warning mean? {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/deliverability/what-does-the-spfdkimdmarc-deliverability-warning-mean}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Email accounts".
- SPF, DKIM, DMARC are email authentication protocols. Missing ones mean more spam, rejections, reputation harm.
- No dedicated flag. Symptoms: accounts in "Error" (red) status, rising bounces, falling opens and replies.
- Pre-warmed and DFY accounts are configured automatically. If provisioning, wait for the "Provisioning domains (X/Y)…" bar (pre-warmed minutes; DFY longer, 2-week warmup).
- Errors on a fully provisioned account: support chat ("Feedback" in the account menu), with the domain name.
b196cddee8246d919b219f7424210812d3d8b7bc:

### Why did my test email land in spam? {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/deliverability/why-did-my-test-email-land-in-spam}

### How do I set the correct timezone for my AI SDR? {slug: ai-sdr/faq/scheduling-calendar/how-do-i-set-the-correct-timezone-for-my-ai-sdr}

### Manage Your Personal Account {slug: account-settings}
Get here: Click the workspace name in the top-left corner, "Settings", then "Profile" under "Account".
- Personal settings apply across all workspaces. Older workspaces: click each setting's own save or update button.
- "Account": "Profile", "Notifications", "Appearance", "Security". "Your calendar": "Email & Calendar", "Availability", "Conferencing".
- "Profile": "Your name", then "Save changes". "Profile picture" > "Upload" (PNG or JPG), crop, save; "Remove" deletes it.
- Email: "Update your email" > "New email" > "Send confirmation". Click the link in the current inbox, then the new inbox's link. Links last about 10 minutes; if expired, resubmit from "Profile". The old email stays your login until both are done.
- "Appearance": "Light", "Dark", "System"; saves instantly.
- "Security" > "Password": 12+ characters, under 73, upper and lowercase, a number; "Save changes". "Email me a link" if forgotten. Signs out other devices. Social login without a password: "Set a password" > "Set password".
- "Two-step sign in" > "Set up": password, "Continue", scan code, 6-digit code, "Turn on", save backup codes (one use each, shown once), "Done". "Turn off…" disables it. Needs a password.
- "Sign-in methods": "Email and password" shows "Active". Google: "Connect"/"Disconnect…"; can't disconnect if it's your only login.
- "Active sessions": sign out a device, or "Sign out of other sessions…".
- "Availability": timezone and "Buffer times" ("Before each meeting", "After each meeting"; "No buffer", "5 minutes", "15 minutes", "30 minutes") save instantly. AI SDR offers avoid buffer overlap.
- Working hours: day on, times, "+" for more blocks, "Save changes"; default 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Copy icon > tick days > "Copy to … days" > "Save changes".
- "Booking link": starts with https://, "Save changes"; the AI SDR includes it.
- "Email & Calendar": in "Connected accounts", "Connect Google"/"Connect Outlook" (or "Connect account"), up to 5. Disconnecting removes it from all workspaces.
- "Put new meetings on", "Busy times come from", "Show my event names to my team" (off shows "External Event") save instantly. Google holidays for US, Canada, Spain block public holidays all day; UK and Australia don't yet.
- "Email": switch on Gmail to sync the last 90 days, per workspace; nothing leaves your inbox. Outlook shows status only.
- "Add new people from email" ("Only people already in your CRM", "Also add people you email") and "Email tracking" ("Track email opens and clicks"): Admin or Owner only.
- "Email signature": per account, "Add signature"/"Edit", "Use workspace template", "Save changes". Admins and Owners edit "Workspace signature template".
- "Conferencing": "Your personal link" > "Save", or "Zoom" > "Connect Zoom". EU Zoom accounts can't connect.
- Delete: "Profile" > "Danger zone" > "Delete account", type DELETE. Deletes workspaces you solely own; restorable 30 days by signing in with the same email, then "Restore my account".
- Fix: finish both email links; connect your calendar in "Email & Calendar".
